name: Taipei 101 Observatory
desc: Once the world's tallest, still the city's exclamation point. The observatory is future-you's treat.

name: Shilin Night Market
desc: A galaxy of sizzling stalls. Entry is free; willpower is not included.

name: Longshan Temple
desc: Incense coils, carved dragons, whispered wishes since 1738. Open late enough for your kind of hours.

name: Elephant Mountain
desc: Twenty sweaty minutes of stairs, then Taipei 101 framed in jungle. The classic free skyline shot.

name: National Palace Museum
desc: An emperors' treasure vault — jade cabbage included. A few bucks for five thousand years of loot.

name: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall
desc: A vast white hall on a plaza built for wide-angle daydreams. Guard change on the hour, free of charge.

name: Beitou Thermal Valley
desc: A steaming jade-green spring that looks borrowed from another planet. Staring is free; soaking nearby is cheap.

name: Maokong Gondola
desc: Glass-bottom cabins floating over tea plantations for pocket change. Mountain teahouses wait at the top.

name: Raohe Street Night Market
desc: One glorious street of pepper buns and neon. The temple at the gate practically blesses your appetite.

name: Tamsui Old Street
desc: Riverside snacks at the end of the metro line. Locals swear the sun sets better out here — go check their math.
